Ravi (People Ops): New handbook update: 'Hybrid Office Etiquette & Visitor Acks' live. Short 4-min ack assigned to all hybrid and onsite staff. Please complete by next Thursday. https://redwood.example.com/hybrid-ack :memo:
Nora (Eng): Does this include contractors who come monthly?
Ravi (People Ops): Yes, all contractors who access offices. Contractors must be added to the visitor system by their host.
Elena (Recruiting): For interview days, can we bulk-ack panelists via event_id? We run large blocks on Tuesdays.
Ravi (People Ops): Added event bulk-ack. Upload CSV with event_id and panelist_emails. Link: https://redwood.example.com/event-bulk-ack
Nora (Eng): Any changes to meeting-room whiteboard rules?
Ravi (People Ops): Reminder: clear whiteboards of sensitive notes before guests arrive. If you need to share sensitive content, use an approved meeting room and log it in the visitor form.
Access Bot: Training assigned (hybrid_etiquette_v1). Due in 7 days.
Elena (Recruiting): Will exports show office_location and host_name? We need to pre-print badges.
Ravi (People Ops): Yes weekly export will include employee_email, completion_ts, host_name, office_location, expected_guest_count. We also added badge_needed and expedited_flag.
Nora (Eng): If someone can't finish before an onsite day, is there an exception?
Ravi (People Ops): Temporary exemptions possible with 48h notice. Use the exemption form; approvals logged in the export.
Access Bot: Export generated (ts: 1799801678) rows: required 188, completed 143, exemptions 8, pending 37. CSV: https://redwood.example.com/exports/1799801678.csv
Elena (Recruiting): I'll chase remaining panelists. Thanks.
